independent_author_oracles.note: Expected Fraction gradients/trajectories and small exact elimination solutions are constructed independently of the production gradient and np.linalg.lstsq.

failure_checks.output_isolation: Existing files byte-identical and new directory absent for invalid input, calculation and serialization failures; symlink-chain and input-collision rejections tested.
failure_checks.fixed_artifact_guards: Altered default config/data/results rejected; 4 figure failure probes preserve old targets and omit new targets; fresh Notebook altered-config run fails in first code cell before creating notebook_outputs.

limitations: Suggested environment is not a tested fresh Anaconda install or cross-platform lock.
Jupyter browser UI and out-of-process socket transport untested; in-process kernel is genuine execution but a different transport.
No GPU, private data, network experiment, or real-world performance claim.
Input grid is deterministic rather than an IID sample; no population error or uncertainty guarantee.
Per-file atomic replacement does not promise a multi-file crash transaction or protection from concurrent path changes.
Strict fixed-artifact byte/data/result agreement can reject line-ending changes or cross-platform floating-point differences.
Fontconfig cache permissions and local-network-interface discovery emitted warnings; generated outputs were separately verified.
source_policy: 6 official/author primary sources opened; failed optional textbook fetch was excluded; no borrowed source figures.
